meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一段文字或笔记做成无人出镜的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有文字稿,想让没有实拍画面的内容变成能发布的视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn written text or notes into an explainer video with no on-camera presenter
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have written content and want a publishable video without filming anything.

howto.what: 你把文章、笔记或一个主题交给 Claude,它会按步骤做成无真人出镜的解说视频:先选设计系统,再规划逐帧讲解脚本,生成配音与音乐,逐帧搭好画面,最后渲染出 MP4。
howto.when: 当你要求把文字做成主题解说、概念拆解或操作教程时触发;若视频要基于网站生成,或意图不明确,会先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利的文章做成一集解说视频
say.note: 进入制作流程,先给出大纲等你确认

say.text: 给我的笔记做一个概念拆解视频,用男声配音
say.note: 会按你的要求选对应音色

say.text: 把这个主题做成无出镜的清单式视频,配轻快音乐
say.note: 音乐按 storyboard 的 music 字段选取

howto.what_en: Hand it an article, notes, or a topic and Claude builds a faceless explainer video step by step: pick a design system, plan a frame-by-frame teaching script, generate narration and music, build the frames, then render an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to turn text into a topic explainer, concept breakdown, or how-to. Videos built from a website, or unclear intent, route through /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into an explainer video
say_en.note: Enters the pipeline and confirms the plan first

say_en.text: Make a concept breakdown video from my notes with a male voice
Turn this topic into a faceless listicle video with upbeat music
say_en.note: Music comes from the storyboard's music field
